description: This GitHub dataset models a green hydrogen-ammonia chemical park in Jilin, China, under grid-connected and islanded operation. The research team provides three hourly CSV datasets for baseline conditions, connected dispatch and off-grid operation across twenty-four weather scenarios. Variables cover electricity exchanges, electrolyser and synthesis loads, thermal demand, waste-heat recovery and battery operation; islanded cases use a 195 MWh battery. The public files are free, with CC BY 4.0 stated in the Data article. They can benchmark multi-energy dispatch and resilience simulations. Baselines derive from a real park, but operational scenarios are constructed under model constraints and do not establish measured islanding performance. No directly related catalogue resource was identified.
